instruction: Fix `RingBuffer.push` so the tail index wraps with modulo once the buffer is full (the current code indexes past the end of the backing array).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds.py b/ds.py
--- a/ds.py
+++ b/ds.py
@@ -75,7 +75,7 @@
         self.size = 0
 
     def push(self, value):
-        tail = self.head + self.size
+        tail = (self.head + self.size) % self.capacity
         self.buf[tail] = value
         if self.size < self.capacity:
             self.size += 1
